skill.summary: 酒店聚合助手，整合分贝通、携程、美团、同程、华住会、锦江等多个酒店数据源，提供统一的酒店搜索、房型查询、预订服务。Invoke when user wants to search hotels across multiple platforms or aggregate hotel data from vario...

latestVersion.changelog:
Global hotel aggregation skill initial release:

- Integrates multiple hotel data sources: 分贝通, 携程, 美团, 同程, 华住会, 锦江
- Provides unified hotel search, room details, price comparison, and booking across platforms
- Standardizes and deduplicates hotel data, showing the best prices and data sources
- Enforces strict rules to ensure data authenticity and accurate price/source display
- Supports core aggregation APIs for unified search, hotel/room details, and price refresh
